title: OpenSanctions Pairs: Large-Scale Entity Matching with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.11051v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We release OpenSanctions Pairs, the first large-scale public benchmark for entity matching on sanctions and OSINT data. The dataset includes 755,540 expert-labeled pairs over 1 million entities, aggregated from 293 source datasets across 45 jurisdictions. It captures real-world diversity in compliance data, spanning multiple languages and writing systems (e.g., Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic), inconsistent structure, and time-varying provenance, and is substantially more heterogeneous than prior entity matching benchmarks. As baselines, we evaluate the production rule-based matcher (nomenklatura RegressionV1) alongside open- and closed-source LLMs in both zero- and few-shot settings, each tested with and without MIPROv2 prompt optimization to control for prompt sensitivity. The rule-based baseline reaches 91.3\% F1; GPT-4o achieves the best result at 99.0\% F1, and a locally deployable open-source model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B)

translated_title: 开放制裁配对：基于大型语言模型的大规模实体匹配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.11051v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们发布了OpenSanctions Pairs，这是首个针对制裁和开源情报数据的大规模公开实体匹配基准测试数据集。该数据集包含755,540个专家标注的配对，覆盖超过100万个实体，聚合自45个司法管辖区的293个源数据集。它捕捉了合规数据中的现实世界多样性，涵盖多种语言和书写系统（如拉丁、西里尔、阿拉伯文）、不一致的结构以及随时间变化的来源，比先前的实体匹配基准测试更具异质性。作为基线，我们评估了基于生产规则匹配器（nomenklatura RegressionV1）以及开源和闭源大型语言模型在零样本和少样本设置下的表现，每种情况均在有无MIPROv2提示优化的情况下进行测试，以控制提示敏感性。基于规则的基线达到91.3%的F1分数；GPT-4o以99.0%的F1分数获得最佳结果，而本地可部署的开源模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B）也表现优异。
tldr: 本文发布了首个大规模制裁数据实体匹配基准，并证明GPT-4o等大型语言模型显著优于传统规则方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first large-scale entity matching benchmark for sanctions data, demonstrating that LLMs like GPT-4o significantly outperform traditional rule-based methods.
